_comment: MAC/DESKTOP MINIMIZED SELF-TEST — closes the last Phase-1 box on real hardware. Proves the ENGINE fires a trusted click while the window is MINIMIZED. On Windows this is PROVEN (PROVEN_FACTS FACT 2); on macOS it is UNPROVEN and this settles it. Run headful (no --headless), minimize within the first 10s, then restore and watch the button turn green 'TRUSTED'. See docs/CAPTURE_GUIDE.md. Command: truklick run recipes/demo/minimized_selftest.json --url "file://$(pwd)/examples/selftest.html"
name: Minimized self-test

steps._note: You have ~10s after the window opens to MINIMIZE it. No hotkey/permission needed.
Window stays open 20s — RESTORE it and check: green 'TRUSTED' = click landed minimized.
